description: Variation of condition 04 of Ref: 22/00516/FUL (varied by 24/03476/VAR) to allow no greater than 20 children at any one time.
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun not later than 28 April 2026, which is the expiry date of the original planning permission ref 22/00516/FUL.Reason: To comply with the Town and Country Act 1990 and in the interest of proper planning.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans as set out in the attached schedule which forms part of this notice. 21/550-01, 21/550-03 A, 21/550-04 A, 21/550-05, 21/550-06, Supporting StatementV1a; Planning Statement dated 18 September 2024;e-mail dated 06.12.2024Neighbours Feedback Form (received 27.05.2025)Covering Letter (received 27.05.2025)Transport Statement (received 19.12.2025)Emails dated 04.04.2026 and 05.05.2026Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

The use hereby approved shall only operate between the hours of 07:30am and 18:00 on Monday to Fridays only.The premises shall not be open for use as a children's nursery on Saturdays, Sundays and Bank Holidays.Reason: To protect the amenities of surrounding residential occupiers.

REPLACEMENT CONDITION 4The capacity of the hereby approved children's nursery use shall be no greater than 20 children at any one time from the date planning permission is issued by the local planning authority. Reason: To prevent harmful intensification of the site and to ensure the proposed use does not prejudice the enjoyment of neighbouring occupiers of their properties.

Within 3 months of this decision notice, a travel plan in accordance with Travel Plan Guidance issued by Transport for London, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved travel plan shall be implemented upon occupation of the nursery and in line with the provisions and timescales set out within the approved travel plan.REASON: In order to comply with the objectives of national and local Planning Policies which promote sustainable development with particular regard to transport.This condition has been discharged via 23/03292/CND and 25/00705/CND.

The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved refuse details (reference 23/03292/CND dated the 7th March 2024) unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.Reason: In the interests of amenity and the recycling of waste materials in support of the Boroughs waste reduction targets.This condition has been discharged via 23/03292/CND.

The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved cycle details (reference 23/03292/CND dated the 7th March 2024) unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To ensure the provision of cycle parking spaces in line with the Council's adopted standards.This condition has been discharged via 23/03292/CND.

Notwithstanding the provisions of Class E(f) of the Schedule of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended) or any amending Order, the premises shall not be used for any purposes other than as a children's day nursery.Reason: To safeguard neighbouring residential amenity.
